# inbox.dog

> OAuth for email, simplified. Three API calls to get Gmail access tokens for your users.

## What it does

Handles the complete Google OAuth 2.0 flow for Gmail API access.
You redirect users to inbox.dog → they authenticate with Google → you get access_token and refresh_token.
Tokens work directly with Gmail API (gmail.googleapis.com).

## Quick Start

1. Create an API key: POST https://inbox.dog/api/keys
2. Redirect user: GET https://inbox.dog/oauth/authorize?client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID&redirect_uri=YOUR_CALLBACK&scope=email
3. Exchange code: POST https://inbox.dog/oauth/token with { code, client_id, client_secret }

Full tutorial: https://inbox.dog/docs/tutorial

## API Endpoints

### POST /api/keys
Create an API key. Returns client_id, client_secret, and 10 free credits.
- Body: { "name": "my-app" }
- Returns: { "client_id": "id_...", "client_secret": "sk_...", "name": "my-app", "credits": 10 }

### GET /api/keys/{client_id}
Get API key info. Requires X-Client-Secret header.
- Headers: X-Client-Secret: YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET
- Returns: { "client_id": "...", "name": "...", "credits": 10, "created_at": 1234567890 }

### GET /oauth/authorize
Start OAuth flow. Redirects user to Google consent screen.
- Params: client_id (required), redirect_uri (required), scope (optional, default: "email"), state (optional)
- After consent: Redirects to your redirect_uri with ?code=AUTH_CODE&state=YOUR_STATE

### POST /oauth/token (authorization_code)
Exchange authorization code for tokens. Costs 1 credit.
- Body: { "code": "AUTH_CODE", "client_id": "YOUR_CLIENT_ID", "client_secret": "YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET" }
- Returns: { "access_token": "ya29...", "refresh_token": "1//...", "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_in": 3600, "email": "user@example.com" }

### POST /oauth/token (refresh_token)
Refresh an expired access token. Free, no credit cost.
- Body: { "grant_type": "refresh_token", "refresh_token": "YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN", "client_id": "YOUR_CLIENT_ID", "client_secret": "YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET" }
- Returns: { "access_token": "ya29...", "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_in": 3600 }

### POST /api/checkout
Purchase more credits via Stripe.
- Body: { "client_id": "YOUR_CLIENT_ID", "client_secret": "YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET", "credits": 100 }
- Returns: { "checkout_url": "https://checkout.stripe.com/...", "session_id": "cs_..." }

## Scopes

| Scope       | Gmail Permission                      |
|-------------|---------------------------------------|
| email       | Read-only access (default)            |
| email:read  | Read-only access                      |
| email:send  | Send emails only                      |
| email:full  | Full access (read, send, modify)      |

## Error Codes

| Code                    | HTTP | Description                                    | Action                              |
|-------------------------|------|------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
| INVALID_CREDENTIALS     | 401  | Invalid client_id or client_secret             | Check your API credentials          |
| INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS    | 402  | No credits remaining                           | Purchase credits via /api/checkout  |
| VALIDATION_ERROR        | 400  | Missing or invalid request parameters          | Check required fields               |
| STATE_NOT_FOUND         | 400  | OAuth state expired or invalid                 | Restart the OAuth flow              |
| AUTH_CODE_NOT_FOUND     | 400  | Authorization code expired (5 min TTL)         | Restart the OAuth flow              |
| TOKEN_EXCHANGE_FAILED   | 500  | Google token exchange failed                   | Retry or check Google OAuth config  |

## Pricing

$0.10 per OAuth token exchange. 10 free credits on signup.
Token refresh is free.
Self-host option available (MIT license).

## MCP Server

inbox.dog has an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for direct agent integration.

Install: npx @inboxdog/mcp-server

Configure in Claude Desktop or any MCP client:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "inbox-dog": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@inboxdog/mcp-server"]
    }
  }
}
```

Available tools:
- inbox_dog_create_key: Create API key (no auth required)
- inbox_dog_oauth_start: Generate Gmail OAuth authorization URL
- inbox_dog_exchange_code: Exchange auth code for access + refresh tokens
- inbox_dog_refresh_token: Refresh an expired access token
- inbox_dog_check_credits: Check remaining credits
